title: CSOAI public-root envelope v0
description: Merkle envelope over public-state cards. This is not a card-v0 leaf and not a GSPC measurement. Ed25519 over the compact preimage {kind, schema, as_of, merkle_root, card_count, did_intended} only. card_sha256[] is bound by merkle_root. GHA on master is the only signer. Not a certificate. Empty GSPC financial slots stay UNMEASURED.

sig_pqc.description: Optional ML-DSA-65 / hybrid signature. Absent or null = UNCHECKABLE, not hidden. Ed25519 stays so old verifiers work.

otel_trace_id.description: Optional OTel trace id for the publish job. Absent = UNCHECKABLE.

otel_trace_hash.description: SHA-256 of the exported OTLP file. Absent = UNCHECKABLE.
